events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Marking 30 years since the tragic passing of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Legacy of a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac's music and powerful lyrics still resonate. Which of his tracks defines an era for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years On
events.blurb: The 56th anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still inspiring generations of guitarists, Jimi Hendrix left us 56 years ago today. His influence is undeniable.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable images in music history!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon whose voice and attitude continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy. What's your favourite Liam track?

events.title: Imagine Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in the UK in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it was in 1971.

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Can you believe it's 25 years since the original iPod dropped? It completely changed the game for portable music. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab a martini and celebrate James Bond Day! We're marking the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the incredible life and enduring music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Sending happy 87th birthday wishes to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still surprises and delights.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The 35th anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost Freddie Mercury. His incredible voice and electrifying stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Game Changer
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' redefined pop music. Which track from this classic album is your favourite?
